rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded/full blastocyst with thinned zona, compact A-grade ICM, and cohesive multicellular TE consistent with the provided 3AA grading; minor hedging between stage 3 and early 4 prevents a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, PCOS, AMH/response, BMI, endometrial thickness, prior IVF history, alcohol use, and paternal age/semen parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, and the implantation estimate follows from embryo quality and patient factors; slight overemphasis on some speculative modifiers keeps it from exemplary.

Generally aligns with Gardner grading, single embryo transfer principles, and standard IVF optimization recommendations; a few suggestions (e.g., sperm DNA fragmentation testing, 10–12 week ultrasound wording) are more conditional than guideline-core.
Provides clear practical recommendations for proceeding with transfer, luteal support review, alcohol cessation, SET, and future-cycle metabolic/endocrine and OHSS planning with appropriate nuance.
